description: Typed crosswalk (DRIFT-005) mapping the comprehensive plan's prose risk register (RISK-001..030, plan §30) to the machine risk vocabulary in registries/RISKS.md. The two namespaces are distinct: prose rows carry plan-facing mitigations; machine rows carry registry-owned mitigations and release consequences. Coverage states: covered (a machine row owns the risk family), partial (a machine row covers part of the family), uncovered (no machine row owns it - exposed gap requiring either a new machine row or an explicit ownership decision). Machine IDs must exist in registries/RISKS.md; every prose row maps exactly once; conflation of the namespaces is prohibited.

crosswalk.prose_risk: Proprietary camera protocols drift frequently
crosswalk.note: proprietary protocol drift is the vendor/adapter risk

crosswalk.prose_risk: DJI Flip lacks a supportable low-latency SDK path
crosswalk.note: DJI Flip SDK path is the SDK-absence risk

crosswalk.prose_risk: Cheap cameras provide poor/unstable timestamps
crosswalk.note: timestamp instability is the clock/buffering corruption risk

crosswalk.prose_risk: Night/IR/weather imagery defeats ordinary detectors
crosswalk.note: detector-defeating imagery is the model calibration/recall risk

crosswalk.prose_risk: Cross-camera association creates privacy-invasive re-identification
crosswalk.note: re-identification is the identity-as-surveillance-network risk

crosswalk.prose_risk: 3D reconstruction looks convincing but is metrically wrong
crosswalk.note: untrustworthy 3D is the geometry certificate risk

crosswalk.prose_risk: Model cascade misses threats filtered by cheap stage
crosswalk.note: cascade misses are the model recall risk; sentinel sampling economics is OPEN-006

crosswalk.prose_risk: Full-resolution continuous inference is economically impossible
crosswalk.note: economics exposure; the operation-cost registry owns measurement, but no dedicated inference-economics risk row exists

crosswalk.prose_risk: Pure-Rust codec/model scope is large and may delay capabilities
crosswalk.note: pure-Rust scope delay is the complexity risk; foreign fallback is the dependency risk

crosswalk.prose_risk: Object store outage or pricing changes break operation
crosswalk.note: object store outage/pricing is the archive economics risk

crosswalk.prose_risk: Franken dependencies are not API-ready
crosswalk.note: Franken API readiness is the dependency/foreign-runtime risk

crosswalk.prose_risk: Event labels are subjective/rare
crosswalk.note: label subjectivity feeds the dataset-quality risk; annotation graph is plan-side mitigation

crosswalk.prose_risk: Zero observed misses causes overconfidence
crosswalk.note: zero-miss overconfidence is the false-assurance risk

crosswalk.prose_risk: Alert provider ambiguity creates duplicates or missing alerts
crosswalk.note: alert ambiguity is the ambiguous-effect/reconciliation risk

crosswalk.prose_risk: Calibration/privacy masks drift after physical movement
crosswalk.note: mask/calibration drift is the stale-coverage risk

crosswalk.prose_risk: Camera vendor terms/accounts resist interoperability
crosswalk.note: vendor terms resistance is the vendor/adapter risk

crosswalk.prose_risk: Local hardware heterogeneity makes performance claims brittle
crosswalk.note: hardware heterogeneity has no machine risk row; platform manifests live in LOCAL_QUALIFICATION_AND_RELEASE only

crosswalk.prose_risk: Search/memory feeds stale harmful assumptions into policy
crosswalk.note: stale memory feeding policy is the dataset/decay family; memory decay is registry doctrine, no dedicated row

crosswalk.prose_risk: Support artifacts leak sensitive footage/secrets
crosswalk.note: support-artifact leakage is the secret-leak risk

crosswalk.prose_risk: Dataset leakage from neighboring frames/properties inflates metrics
crosswalk.note: leakage inflation is the dataset risk

crosswalk.prose_risk: System normalizes excessive household/bystander surveillance
crosswalk.note: surveillance normalization is the over-collection risk

crosswalk.prose_risk: Residents/guests do not understand collection
crosswalk.note: comprehensibility is the privacy-doctrine family; no dedicated comprehensibility row

crosswalk.prose_risk: False alarms create panic or dangerous escalation
crosswalk.note: false-alarm severity is the model calibration family; no dedicated false-alarm row

crosswalk.prose_risk: Missed event creates false sense of certainty
crosswalk.note: missed-event false certainty is the false-assurance risk

crosswalk.prose_risk: Evidence export is misleading after transforms
crosswalk.note: export trustworthiness has no machine risk row; chain-of-custody is plan-side doctrine

crosswalk.prose_risk: Cloud/remote model silently receives sensitive data
crosswalk.note: cloud data egress spans the privacy and secret risks

crosswalk.prose_risk: Project is repurposed for oppressive tracking
crosswalk.note: repurposing exposure is the biometric-network family; scope doctrine is plan-side

crosswalk.prose_risk: Children/interior spaces receive disproportionate collection
crosswalk.note: children/interior collection is the privacy minimization family; P3 defaults are plan-side

crosswalk.prose_risk: Operator cannot maintain a complex system
crosswalk.note: operator maintainability has no machine risk row; doctor/CLI doctrine is plan-side

crosswalk.prose_risk: Vendor account compromise propagates into trusted core
crosswalk.note: vendor account compromise is the secret/capability isolation risk
